answer: The engraver shop is quiet but for the graver biting copper. Proof of engraver via plate cut tally — a plate the engraver cuts only after 28 plates print clean on the press, each plate cut by the engraver himself. grove steadies the plate in the pitch and cuts the first line deep. inlet inks the plate and pulls a proof to read the lines. beacon wipes the surface clean and checks each cut under the glass. A man faking it must cut 28 plates that all print clean, and the next one still blurs where the burin slipped.
